# dbaas_quota (Data Source)

Read commercial quota through a selected zone. The server reports environment/account-wide limits and usage, not a separate per-zone allowance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Exact configured DBaaS zone name or UUID. Use the computed UUID for subsequent operations.

### Read-Only

- `allocated` (Attributes) allocated (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocated))
- `limits` (Attributes) limits (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `observed_at` (String) observed at
- `override` (Boolean) override
- `remaining` (Attributes) remaining (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remaining))
- `reserved` (Attributes) reserved (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reserved))
- `scope` (String) scope
- `zone_id` (String) Resolved routing zone UUID.
